"Create a mobile 3D jetski racing game for Android and iOS, set on a tropical wild river. Portrait and landscape supported.

*Title: River Rush - Jetski Racing Mobile*

*Platform:* Unity mobile or Unreal mobile, optimized for low-mid range devices, 60 FPS target, touch controls, APK size under 150MB.

*Core Gameplay:*
- Player vs 5 AI opponents, 3 laps per race, checkpoint system
- Race modes: Career Mode, Quick Race, Time Trial

*Mobile Controls:*
- Control Option 1: Tilt steering using gyroscope + auto acceleration
- Control Option 2: Left thumb joystick to steer, right thumb button for nitro boost and brake
- Swipe up to jump over waves, tap nitro button when meter is full
- Auto-acceleration enabled, player focuses on steering and timing

*Mobile-Specific Mechanics:*
- Simplified water physics optimized for mobile: wave bobbing, river current drift, splash particles using lightweight VFX
- Drift to fill nitro: Hold turn on curves to trigger drift sparks and charge boost
- Obstacles: Rocks, floating logs, whirlpools that slow down. Collision gives short stun and speed loss.
- Power-ups: Nitro (blue), Shield (yellow), Coin for shop
- Speed ramps and waterfall jumps with slow-motion effect

*Track Design:*
- River track 30m wide, winding S-curves, narrow jungle sections, wooden bridges, village riverside
- Short tracks designed for 90-120 second races, perfect for mobile sessions
- Visual: Stylized realistic, bright tropical, low-poly jungle with detailed water shader (mobile-friendly), water color brownish-green, foam effects

*Progression @COMMENT_BODY@ Monetization (Mobile Ready):*
- Unlockable jetskis with different stats: Speed, Handling, Boost
- Coins earned from races to upgrade jetski
- Daily rewards, missions

*UI/HUD Mobile:*
- Big touch-friendly buttons, thumb-reachable
- Top: Position 1/6, Lap 1/3, minimap
- Bottom: Speedometer, Nitro bar with glowing effect when full, Pause button
- No text clutter

*Performance Optimization:*
- LOD system, baked lighting, object pooling for splash, mobile water shader
- Haptics vibration on collision and boost, engine sound with doppler

Build with Unity URP for mobile, C# scripts, touch input system.
"

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Objective
- Build a mobile 3D jetski racing game, “River Rush — Jetski Racing Mobile,” with a tropical wild-river setting, portrait/landscape support, racing, progression, touch controls, and performance-focused presentation.
- Unity/Unreal is unavailable in this environment, so implement a playable Three.js/WebGL equivalent with Vite instead.

## Requirements
- Player vs 5 AI, 3 laps, checkpoints; modes: Career, Quick Race, Time Trial.
- Touch controls: gyroscope tilt + auto acceleration, or left joystick + right nitro/brake; swipe up to jump; tap nitro when full.
- Mechanics: mobile water physics, wave bobbing, current drift, drift-charged nitro with sparks, rocks/logs/whirlpools, collision stun, Nitro/Shield/Coin pickups, ramps/waterfall jumps with slow-motion.
- Track: 30 m winding river, S-curves, narrow jungle, wooden bridge, village, 90–120 sec races, bright low-poly tropical visuals, brown-green water/foam.
- Progression: unlockable jetskis with Speed/Handling/Boost stats, coin upgrades, daily rewards, missions.
- HUD: position, lap, minimap, speedometer, glowing nitro bar, pause, big thumb-friendly controls, minimal text.
- Performance: mobile-friendly water shader, LOD/instancing, baked-style lighting, object pooling, haptics, engine sound with doppler.
- Target 60 FPS and APK under 150 MB (web build currently; packaging not implemented).

## Decisions
- Use Vite + Three.js 0.187 because no Unity installation or native mobile build pipeline exists here.
- All art/audio generated procedurally or with downloaded fonts; no external model/audio dependencies.
- Persist progression in `localStorage` under `riverRush.save.v1`.
- Primary menu button must have accessible name exactly “Start” so the capture harness auto-starts Quick Race.
- Use a modular game architecture: Track, Water, Environment, RaceObjects, JetSki, Player, AI, Effects, Audio, Input, UI, Progress, Game.
- Keep capture-friendly menu/game presentation, with a cinematic countdown camera and immediate playable race scene.

## Work State
### Completed
- Project scaffolding: `package.json`, Vite config via scripts, fonts downloaded to `public/fonts`.
- Full `index.html` markup for loading, menu, HUD, pause, results, panels, toasts, overlays.
- Full responsive `src/style.css` for desktop/portrait/landscape/mobile.
- Core utilities and progression/save system (`utils.js`, `Progress.js`), including jetski catalog, career events, daily rewards, missions, upgrades.
- Track spline with width variation, 8 checkpoints, minimap cache, CPU wave function.
- Water ribbon geometry + mobile shader with waves, foam, fresnel, sun specular, fog.
- Environment: sky shader, sun, lights, terrain banks, instanced palms/broadleaf/bushes/rocks/bamboo, clouds, mountains, birds, start arch, bridge, stilt village, waterfall, start lights.
- RaceObjects: checkpoint poles/flags, start line, rocks/logs/whirlpools, Nitro/Shield/Coin pickups, ramps, buoys, collision/collect helpers.
- JetSki procedural model with hull, rider, shield, glow, shadow.
- Player physics: auto acceleration, steering, drifting/nitro charge, boost/super boost, jumps, collisions, checkpoints/laps, race distance, edge clamps.
- AI opponent logic with lanes, curve slowdown, rubber-banding, ramp jumps, wake.
- Particle effects pools (foam, sparks, splash, boost, pickups) and procedural WebAudio engine/water/doppler/SFX.
- Input: joystick, nitro/brake buttons, swipe jump, keyboard, tilt/gyro permission and calibration.
- UI: menu, HUD, minimap, career, garage with SVG previews/upgrades, daily/missions, settings, results, pause, toasts, responsive hooks.
- Main `Game.js` orchestrator with race flow, camera modes, countdown, finish/results, quality scaling, palette switching, loading, loop.

### Active
- Integration validation: just finished writing `src/main.js`? Not yet created.
- Need to wire `main.js` import and instantiate `Game`, run Vite build, and fix syntax/runtime errors.
- Need visual capture and gameplay smoke testing with Playwright.
- Need tune gameplay/visuals after screenshots.

### Blocked
- No native Unity/Unreal build available; only web deployment possible.
- Need browser tooling verification; Playwright is available via `playwright-cli` / runtime scripts.

## Next Move
1. Create `src/main.js` importing `./style.css` and `Game`, instantiate on DOM ready, handle boot errors visibly.
2. Run `npm run build` (or `npx vite build --base ./`) and fix all compile/runtime errors.
3. Start preview on port 3002/default, open with Playwright, inspect menu and race screenshots in desktop/mobile viewports.
4. Verify: START launches race, countdown works, player/AI move, checkpoints/laps advance, pickups/obstacles/hazards trigger, nitro/drift/jump work, pause/results flow works, portrait + landscape layouts fit.
5. Fix known implementation issues found during review:
   - `src/ui/UI.js` `openSettings` segmented helper uses wrong value key (`s.quality` for control); fix signature.
   - `src/ui/UI.js` equip button (`data-select` + `data-action="equip"`) currently only previews, does not call `progress.selectJetSki`.
   - `src/game/AI.js` jump detection `crossed !== now` logic is incorrect; simplify with previous-t/last-t crossing.
   - `src/game/Player.js` `boostCount` fractional accumulation should be integer event count only.
   - `src/game/Game.js` start grid/HUD: player `START_T=0.981`, AI rows currently put AI ahead; intended arrangement is player on pole with AI mostly beside/behind for HUD showing 1/6.
   - Add `Effects.clear()` / particle pool clear used defensively in `Game.startRace`.
   - Verify `Camera` `fov` update and menu framing not clipping title/hero overlay.
   - Check `Environment.buildVillage` rotation/dock orientation and start arch banner readability.
   - Ensure no page errors from `CanvasRenderingContext2D.letterSpacing`, `roundRect`, imported addons, or WebGL shader compile.
   - Verify `AudioEngine` optional `tone` call via `this.audio.tone?.` works.
6. Update `README.md` with how to run, controls, features, and note the web/Three.js implementation.

## Objective
- Build a mobile 3D jetski racing game, “River Rush — Jetski Racing Mobile,” with a tropical wild-river setting, portrait/landscape support, racing, progression, touch controls, and performance-focused presentation.
- Unity/Unreal is unavailable, so implement a playable Three.js/WebGL equivalent with Vite.

## Requirements
- Player vs 5 AI, 3 laps, checkpoints; modes: Career, Quick Race, Time Trial.
- Touch controls: gyroscope tilt + auto acceleration, or left joystick + right nitro/brake; swipe up to jump; tap nitro when full.
- Mechanics: mobile water physics, wave bobbing, current drift, drift-charged nitro with sparks, rocks/logs/whirlpools, collision stun, Nitro/Shield/Coin pickups, ramps/waterfall jumps with slow-motion.
- Track: 30 m winding river, S-curves, narrow jungle, wooden bridge, village, 90–120 sec races, bright low-poly tropical visuals, brown-green water/foam.
- Progression: unlockable jetskis with Speed/Handling/Boost stats, coin upgrades, daily rewards, missions.
- HUD: position, lap, minimap, speedometer, glowing nitro bar, pause, big thumb-friendly controls, minimal text.
- Performance: mobile-friendly water shader, LOD/instancing, baked-style lighting, object pooling, haptics, engine sound with doppler.
- Target 60 FPS and APK under 150 MB (web build currently; packaging not implemented).
- Primary menu button must have accessible name exactly “Start” so the capture harness auto-starts Quick Race.

## Decisions
- Use Vite + Three.js 0.187 because no Unity installation or native mobile build pipeline exists.
- All art/audio generated procedurally or with downloaded fonts; no external model/audio dependencies.
- Persist progression in `localStorage` under `riverRush.save.v1`.
- Keep capture-friendly menu/game presentation, with a cinematic countdown camera and immediate playable race scene.
- Keep modular architecture: Track, Water, Environment, RaceObjects, JetSki, Player, AI, Effects, Audio, Input, UI, Progress, Game.
- Leave custom water/sky/fall/effects shaders outputting raw colors (no `<tonemapping_fragment>`/`<colorspace_fragment>`) because adding them washed the scene out; tune palette hex values instead.

## Work State
### Completed
- Project scaffolding, fonts, full `index.html`, responsive `src/style.css`.
- Core utilities, progression/save system, career events, daily rewards, missions, upgrades.
- Track spline with 8 checkpoints, minimap cache, CPU wave function.
- Water ribbon geometry/shader; sky, terrain, instanced jungle, clouds, mountains, birds, start arch, bridge, village, waterfall, start lights.
- RaceObjects: checkpoint poles/flags, start line, rocks/logs/whirlpools, pickups, ramps, buoys, collision/collect helpers.
- Procedural JetSki model with rider, shield, glow, shadow.
- Player physics, AI opponents, effects pools, procedural audio, input (joystick/tilt/swipe/keyboard), UI panels/HUD, `Game.js` orchestrator.
- Created `src/main.js` with boot error overlay; build succeeds.
- Fixed runtime boot crash in `JetSki.js` caused by wrapping `cylBetween()` mesh in another `new THREE.Mesh(...)`.
- Fixed UI settings segmented active state, garage locked-ski preview fallback, and equip action.
- Fixed AI ramp-crossing detection with `wrappedCrossed`.
- Fixed player `boostCount` fractional accumulation; removed double-count on super-boost start.
- Reset `Player.lastHint` on reset; added `Effects.clear()`.
- Repositioned AI start grid behind player pole so opening HUD reads 1/6.
- Fixed portrait logo overflow and portrait countdown camera framing.
- Brightened instanced foliage by using white base materials with per-instance colors; reduced canopy/bush sizes.
- Brightened water/terrain palette values.
- Added `public/favicon.svg` and linked it to remove favicon 404.
- Moved bridge supports to banks so the river lane is clear.
- Verified via Playwright: menu, countdown, racing, results, pause/resume/restart, settings, garage preview/buy/equip/upgrade, daily claim, mission claim, joystick steering, nitro super boost, swipe jump, checkpoint/lap progression.
- Verified build output and basic rendering; no page-startup console errors remain.

### Active
- Final visual/functional polish after screenshot review.
- Need rebuild after latest bridge-support edit.
- Need inspect waterfall scene; latest screenshot showed waterfall partially hidden behind large foreground foliage/rocks.
- Need update `README.md` with run instructions, controls, features, and web/Three.js implementation note.
- Need final clean screenshot set and final build verification.

### Blocked
- No native Unity/Unreal build or APK packaging available; only web deployment possible.
- Browser rendering is SwiftShader software (about 20 FPS in test), so cannot verify real-device 60 FPS or GPU acceleration here.

1. Rebuild with `npm run build` and reload preview on port 3002.

"Create a mobile 3D jetski racing game for Android and iOS, set on a tropical wild river. Portrait and landscape supported.

*Title: River Rush - Jetski Racing Mobile*

*Platform:* Unity mobile or Unreal mobile, optimized for low-mid range devices, 60 FPS target, touch controls, APK size under 150MB.

*Core Gameplay:*
- Player vs 5 AI opponents, 3 laps per race, checkpoint system
- Race modes: Career Mode, Quick Race, Time Trial

*Mobile Controls:*
- Control Option 1: Tilt steering using gyroscope + auto acceleration
- Control Option 2: Left thumb joystick to steer, right thumb button for nitro boost and brake
- Swipe up to jump over waves, tap nitro button when meter is full
- Auto-acceleration enabled, player focuses on steering and timing

*Mobile-Specific Mechanics:*
- Simplified water physics optimized for mobile: wave bobbing, river current drift, splash particles using lightweight VFX
- Drift to fill nitro: Hold turn on curves to trigger drift sparks and charge boost
- Obstacles: Rocks, floating logs, whirlpools that slow down. Collision gives short stun and speed loss.
- Power-ups: Nitro (blue), Shield (yellow), Coin for shop
- Speed ramps and waterfall jumps with slow-motion effect

*Track Design:*
- River track 30m wide, winding S-curves, narrow jungle sections, wooden bridges, village riverside
- Short tracks designed for 90-120 second races, perfect for mobile sessions
- Visual: Stylized realistic, bright tropical, low-poly jungle with detailed water shader (mobile-friendly), water color brownish-green, foam effects

*Progression @COMMENT_BODY@ Monetization (Mobile Ready):*
- Unlockable jetskis with different stats: Speed, Handling, Boost
- Coins earned from races to upgrade jetski
- Daily rewards, missions

*UI/HUD Mobile:*
- Big touch-friendly buttons, thumb-reachable
- Top: Position 1/6, Lap 1/3, minimap
- Bottom: Speedometer, Nitro bar with glowing effect when full, Pause button
- No text clutter

*Performance Optimization:*
- LOD system, baked lighting, object pooling for splash, mobile water shader
- Haptics vibration on collision and boost, engine sound with doppler

Build with Unity URP for mobile, C# scripts, touch input system.
"
